display_long_description:
Oh My Galaxy! is an immersive puzzle game where you use a cosmic slingshot to fire asteroids at alien invaders that are attacking defenceless planets.                                                                                                                                                                         

[media]

Using hand tracking or controllers, combine the gravitational pull of the planets with the special powers of your asteroids to perform incredible trick shots.

[media]

Your goal is to destroy the alien invaders as efficiently as possible. Set great scores to earn more stars, unlocking over 100 levels of planetary puzzles to solve.

[media]

Play in a choice of mixed reality or VR on Quest 3 and 3S, or in fantastic immersive VR on Quest 2, to experience Oh My Galaxy! brought to life in your home or headset.

[media]
